description_en: Retrieves accelerated domain names based on certificate information
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnDomainByCertificate根据证书信息获取加速域名
name: DescribeCdnDomainByCertificate

parameters.help_en: The public key of the certificate. The key must be Base64-encoded before being URL-encoded by using encodeURIComponent. PEM format is supported
parameters.help_zh:
证书公钥，需要base64编码后再进行encodeURIComponent。

支持pem格式
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the returned domain name list includes only domain names with HTTPS enabled or disabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
表示返回的域名列表只包含开启或关闭HTTPS的域名。

true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: ssl_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the returned domain name list exactly matches the certificate. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
表示返回的域名列表是否与证书精准匹配。
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: exact

CertCaIsLegacy.description_en:
The deprecation status of the certificate CA. Valid values:

yes: Deprecated.

no: Normal and not deprecated
CertCaIsLegacy.description_zh:
证书CA废弃状态。取值：

yes：已废弃。

no：正常，未废弃

CertExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate. The time format is MMM DD HH:mm:ss YYYY GMT
CertExpireTime.description_zh: 证书过期时间。时间格式为 MMM DD HH:mm:ss YYYY GMT

CertExpired.description_en:
The expiration status of the certificate. Valid values:

yes: Expired.

no: Not expired
CertExpired.description_zh:
证书过期状态。 取值：

yes：已过期。

no：未过期

CertStartTime.description_en: The start time of the certificate. The time format is MMM DD HH:mm:ss YYYY GMT
CertStartTime.description_zh: 证书开始时间。时间格式为 MMM DD HH:mm:ss YYYY GMT

CertSubjectCommonName.description_en: The name of the certificate owner

CertType.description_en: The type of the certificate. Valid values: RSA, DSA, and ECDSA

DomainList.description_en: The list of domain names matched against the certificate. If this value is not empty, multiple domain names are separated by commas (,)
DomainList.description_zh: 如果该返回值不为空，则将该列表与证书做匹配，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔

DomainNames.description_en: The domain names matched by the certificate, which are specified in the DNS field. Multiple domain names are separated by commas (,)
DomainNames.description_zh: 证书匹配的域名（DNS字段），多个用英文逗号（,）分隔

Issuer.example: C=US, O=Symantec Corporation, OU=Symantec Trust Network, OU=Domain Validated SSL, CN=Symantec Basic DV SSL CA - G1
